profile_summary: Judge-approved hypothetical clean Ontario G driver; 2025 Toyota Corolla LE; planned/new/financed; 5,000 km/year; no VIN; no fabricated address, contact consent or licence number.
truth_note: A route entrance, insurer logo, marketing example, engine-generated reference or another participant's result is not a price. Only a premium returned for this run with source, underwriter and coverage evidence counts.

routes.name: Allstate
routes.test_depth: Postal code and Auto were mapped on the current Quick Quote intake. The official Go submission returned ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR; the bounded retry was not converted into a quote.
routes.user_action_required: Retry once later or use another route. Do not infer a premium from the failed page.
routes.evidence_note: A real 2026-08-11 browser attempt failed after the postal-code step.

routes.name: Aviva Direct
routes.test_depth: Vehicle, driver and history were completed. The official Double-check assumptions declaration appeared and reference Q022763742 was generated.
routes.user_action_required: Personally review the assumptions and click the declaration, then resume the same tab.
routes.evidence_note: A reference proves journey progress, not a premium. Ontario underwriter disclosed as S&Y Insurance Company.

routes.name: Square One
routes.test_depth: The working quote journey stopped at a Google-Places-style full residential/garaging address before vehicle questions.
routes.user_action_required: Authorize and select the applicant's real address suggestion on the official page.
routes.evidence_note: Square One is the distributor; Ontario car insurance is underwritten by Zurich.

routes.name: Rates.ca
routes.test_depth: Vehicle, driver, history and discounts were completed. The final page required email, phone and consent to quote follow-up before showing results.
routes.user_action_required: Enter authorized contact details and personally choose whether to accept follow-up consent.
routes.evidence_note: Rates.ca is an intermediary. Each returned carrier must be normalized separately.

routes.name: TD Insurance
routes.test_depth: A full 2025 Corolla route was completed through vehicle, use, coverage, discounts and driver identity. The next page required a complete residential address. Selecting gender X routed directly to phone support.
routes.user_action_required: Provide a real residential/garaging address. If the applicant uses gender X, use TD's phone route instead of claiming web completion.
routes.evidence_note: The tested Ontario journey disclosed TD General Insurance Company.

routes.name: CAA Insurance
routes.test_depth: The live first page required full address, effective date, risk declarations and acceptance of privacy/terms before vehicle questions.
routes.user_action_required: Enter the real address and personally accept the displayed privacy/terms statement.
routes.evidence_note: CAA membership is optional for basic eligibility but may affect discounts.

routes.name: Desjardins Insurance
routes.test_depth: The Ontario quote application was opened directly. In connected Chrome it exposed only the application document and reCAPTCHA frame, with no safe form controls.
routes.user_action_required: Complete visible human verification if the site permits it, then resume; no bypass is attempted.
routes.evidence_note: The returned Certas legal entity must be captured from the result rather than assumed.

routes.name: belairdirect
routes.test_depth: The official landing page listed driver's licence, vehicle and home-address requirements. Its quote application rendered a blank shell plus an invisible reCAPTCHA in connected Chrome.
routes.user_action_required: Complete human verification and use only the applicant's real licence/address if the form becomes available.
routes.evidence_note: Belair Insurance Company Inc. is the legal underwriter in the seed and official disclosure.

routes.name: Sonnet
routes.test_depth: The official quote requirements were checked against the planned-vehicle profile.
routes.user_action_required: Use a real VIN and Ontario driver's licence number. Neither may be fabricated for this test.
routes.evidence_note: This is a valid online route, but it is not executable for the current no-VIN profile.

routes.name: LowestRates.ca
routes.test_depth: The 2025 Corolla vehicle, driver, history and discount flow was completed. The final Get Free Quotes page required email, phone and disclosure/follow-up consent.
routes.user_action_required: Supply authorized contact details and personally accept or decline follow-up consent.
routes.evidence_note: Displayed results would remain estimates until a licensed broker or insurer confirms them.

routes.name: Co-operators
routes.test_depth: The current IRAuto first page required vehicle year, full address, coverage start date and explicit privacy/collection agreement.
routes.user_action_required: Enter the real address and personally agree to the displayed privacy collection notice.
routes.evidence_note: The route disclosed Co-operators General Insurance Company; affinity entities require separate returned evidence.

routes.name: RBC Insurance
routes.test_depth: Postal code opened the live vehicle form. The form is the same Aviva BOL engine family used by other Aviva-distributed routes and proceeds through vehicle, driver and declaration stages.
routes.user_action_required: Complete the route and personally review the final assumptions/declaration.
routes.evidence_note: RBC Insurance Agency is the distributor and Aviva General Insurance Company is disclosed as underwriter; do not count the engine twice without a distinct returned program.

routes.name: The Personal
routes.test_depth: The current group auto-insurance journey and eligibility requirement were verified.
routes.user_action_required: Provide a real eligible employer, professional, union or alumni relationship.
routes.evidence_note: The Personal is not an unrestricted general-public route.

routes.name: Surex
routes.test_depth: A live quote ID was created and the vehicle page opened. Before progression it required vehicle details and selection of the full address where the vehicle will be parked.
routes.user_action_required: Authorize and select the real parking/garaging address, then resume the same quote ID.
routes.evidence_note: Surex is a licensed brokerage, not the underwriter. Marketing example prices were ignored.

routes.name: ThinkInsure
routes.test_depth: The live quote form required policy date, legal name, email, phone and reCAPTCHA before vehicle questions.
routes.user_action_required: Provide authorized contact details and complete reCAPTCHA yourself.
routes.evidence_note: The page states that online figures are estimates and a licensed advisor may need more information.

routes.name: Onlia
routes.test_depth: The first personal-information page required legal name, full street address, policy date, Ontario driver's licence number and acceptance of terms.
routes.user_action_required: Use the applicant's real address/licence and personally accept the terms before lookup.
routes.evidence_note: Onlia supports planned vehicles, but identity lookup remains a mandatory human checkpoint.

routes.name: PC Insurance
routes.test_depth: Vehicle, driver and history were completed and reference Q022764054 was generated. The final assumptions required the vehicle to be registered in Ontario and owned/registered to the applicant or spouse, which conflicts with the current planned-vehicle profile.
routes.user_action_required: Use a truthfully owned/registered vehicle profile or stop; do not attest to a false ownership assumption.
routes.evidence_note: PC Insurance is the broker/distributor and the tested journey disclosed Aviva General Insurance Company.

routes.name: Inova
routes.test_depth: The current auto quote form required email, phone and a disclosure-attestation checkbox before starting; driver's licence was optional at this step.
routes.user_action_required: Provide authorized contact details and personally confirm the disclosure acknowledgement.
routes.evidence_note: Partner logos do not count until the returned result names a carrier and premium.

routes.name: InsuranceHotline.com
routes.test_depth: The live route opened insurancehotlineservices.insurancehotline.com and exposed the same Vehicle / Driver / Discount RATESDOTCA engine as LowestRates. The duplicate journey was not resubmitted after the identical final contact-consent gate was proven.
routes.user_action_required: Use one RATESDOTCA-family route for the profile, then deduplicate returned carriers rather than submitting repeated lead forms.
routes.evidence_note: A second brand on the same engine is not automatically a distinct rate source.

routes.name: MyChoice
routes.test_depth: The public quote journey and current Terms of Use were reviewed.
routes.user_action_required: Use a permitted manual/reference path only; ReachRate does not automate this destination.
routes.evidence_note: MyChoice is a comparison/referral platform, not the legal underwriter.

routes.name: Scoop Insurance
routes.test_depth: The previously cited auto page returned a missing-page experience and no current price-capable quote form was verified.
routes.user_action_required: Do not claim a Scoop quote until a current official route is found.
routes.evidence_note: Its corporate relationship with Rates.ca does not prove a separate route or rate.

routes.name: Ontario Mutuals locator
routes.test_depth: The public locator route was verified; it identifies territory-specific mutuals rather than returning one central premium.
routes.user_action_required: Select the applicable local mutual, then use that mutual's agent or broker route.
routes.evidence_note: The locator itself is not a quote source.

routes.name: Hagerty collector program
routes.test_depth: Official eligibility and underwriting disclosures were verified. The program is for collector vehicles not used as a daily driver.
routes.user_action_required: Use only for an eligible collector vehicle and household; the 2025 Corolla daily-driver test is out of scope.
routes.evidence_note: Official current disclosure names Elite Insurance Company, an Aviva subsidiary, for the standard collector program.

routes.name: Facility Association
routes.test_depth: The official residual-market operating model was verified. Facility Association is an administrator, and policies are accessed through a licensed broker/agent and servicing carrier.
routes.user_action_required: Use a licensed intermediary only when a voluntary-market insurer has declined the risk under an approved rule.
routes.evidence_note: Facility Association is not a normal direct consumer quote website.
